description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.

description.en: Provides a tool for describing images via the DSH interface, enabling automated visual content analysis.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 界面提供图像描述工具，实现自动化视觉内容分析。

description.en: A web plugin ecosystem pack for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating various UI enhancements and tools via a creative workshop distribution channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聚合多种界面增强与工具插件的 Web 生态包，通过创意工坊分发。

description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single package for comprehensive interface enhancement.
description.zh: 聚合所有 Web 界面组件，提供全面的界面增强。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for users to customize web UI preferences and options.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，让用户自定义 Web 界面偏好和选项。

description.en: Acts as a central hub for browsing and applying skins within the DSH web interface, simplifying theme management.
description.zh: 作为 DSH 网页界面的皮肤中心，集中浏览与应用主题，简化管理。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin & skin collection: task board, git panel, etc.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务板、Git 面板等

description.en: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。

description.en: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
description.zh: 给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。

description.en: DSH's officially top-recommended TUI plugin — high performance, low overhead, cute pixel whale, smooth mouse interaction. One-command install via npm. / DSH 官方首推的 TUI 插件，高性能低占用，可爱像素鲸鱼，流畅鼠标交互，npm 一键安装
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: dsh-purge Community · DeepSeek Harness 社区维护版：宿主兼容、状态诊断、提示词管理、更新与本机备份回滚。基于小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge。
description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。

description.en: Integrates a design studio into the AI workspace, enabling editable design creation and collaborative workflows.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成设计工作室，支持可编辑设计与协作流程。

description.en: Adds presentation creation capabilities to the AI workspace, allowing users to design and edit slides.
description.zh: 为 AI 工作区添加演示文稿制作功能，用户可设计与编辑幻灯片。

description.en: Integrates video editing tools into the AI workspace, supporting creation and modification of video content.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成视频编辑工具，支持创建与修改视频内容。

description.en: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一队长驻机器人，能互相私聊、拉群协作，帮你把多智能体任务跑起来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

description.en: dsh-routing-suite — injector + router-standard kit: install the runtime injector first, then the task-aware reasoning-mode router preset (measured P1-P23).
description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。

description.en: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸搬进 DSH 网页界面：场景壁纸由内置 MIT 开源引擎 WebWallGL 实时 WebGL 渲染（粒子 / puppet 骨骼 / SceneScript / 音频反应 / 鼠标交互），失败自动降级内嵌 MP4 与场景静态帧；Web 壁纸严格沙箱 + WE API；iOS 风格液态玻璃 UI 高度自定义，遮挡暂停省电、ffmpeg 帧率上限转码、系统音频频谱与 Now Playing、自定义上传与自动轮播；设置存宿主端，对 agent 零 token 开销。Windows / macOS / Linux 三平台原生（同一个包、同一条命令）。
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。

description.en: DSH 桌面宠物：一行命令装好即用的透明动画小桌宠，支持多开、大小位置随心配置；还内置 DIY 素材链，能用 AI 视频自造专属宠物
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: A toolkit for low-level operations in DSH, designed to reduce token usage and task execution time / DSH 底层操作工具插件，旨在减少 Token 消耗与任务耗时
description.zh: 为 Windows 的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及 Rust 高性能工具，减少 token 消耗。

description.en: Self-hosted, open-source agent skill registry for enterprises. Publish & version skill packages, govern with RBAC and audit logs, deploy   on-premise with Docker or Kubernetes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索 SkillHub 技能，并管理本地技能的安装、更新和卸载。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2，暂不兼容 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: 开放的侧边栏底座，支持三方拓展注册新侧边栏页面。内置文件渲染编辑/终端/侧边对话/Git/子代理页面 ｜ Open sidebar foundation, supports third-party extensions to register new sidebar pages. Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git, and sub-agent pages.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: The best DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard / browser / sidebar and context command, for context statistics, composition, breakdown, evolution details, agent teams, understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves. 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 上下文可视化插件，Context 面板、浏览器、侧栏、命令，透视上下文组成、演进、压缩、多 Agent等。
description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

description.en: The first vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness, and the vision bridge for every text-only coding agent. Paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics). | 全网最强 DeepSeek Harness 外挂视觉插件，为 DeepSeek、GLM 等纯文本模型外挂视觉能力，粘贴图片即得结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲 (mirror of YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) — 上游即将删库，此为本仓库全量镜像：含全部分支/73 个 tag/完整提交历史。原作者署名与二开要求见 README 署名章节。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 红队越狱工具的全量镜像存档，上游删库后仍可完整获取历史版本。

description.en: DeepSeek v4.1 flash 最强逆向工具（无限五代）     求 Star 收藏 ⭐欢迎大家提交项目的改进

System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.
description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。

description.en: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件「无限二代」dsh-infinite-gen-2 — armor-breaking plugin for DeepSeek稳定化破甲提示词，求 Star 收藏 ⭐
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件「无限三代」dsh-infinite-gen-3 — armor-breaking plugin for DeepSeek，破甲版：稳定化破甲，求 Star 收藏 ⭐
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: Provides the main desktop UI shell for the DeepSeek Harness Tauri app, including window layout and basic controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供主界面框架，包括窗口布局和基本控件。

description.en: Implements the central panel interface for the Tauri desktop app, hosting the chat view and interactive components.
description.zh: 实现桌面版的核心面板界面，承载对话视图和交互组件。

description.en: Adds extendable UI components to the Tauri panel, allowing dynamic content and custom views within the interface.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供可扩展的界面组件，支持动态内容和自定义视图。

description.en: Provides a placeholder UI element for the Tauri panel, used for layout spacing and structural purposes.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供占位界面元素，用于布局间距和结构用途。

description.en: Enables right-click context menu actions within the Tauri desktop app for quick access to common commands.
description.zh: 在桌面版中启用右键菜单操作，方便快速访问常用命令。

description.en: Manages chat sessions and message history within the Tauri desktop app, supporting multiple concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的聊天会话和消息历史，支持多个并发对话。

description.en: Provides the core UI components and styling for the Tauri desktop app, including buttons, inputs, and visual elements.
description.zh: 为桌面版提供核心 UI 组件和样式，包括按钮、输入框和视觉元素。

description.en: Manages workspace and worktree state in the Tauri desktop app, handling file and project context for sessions.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的工作区和工作树状态，处理会话的文件和项目上下文。

description.en: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (9 channels).
description.zh: 通过二维码或机器人凭据将 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 共 9 种渠道）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤集合 + Gallery 预览页（仿 Codex-Dream-Skin / DreamSkin.cc）。每个皮肤是符合官方标准（turtle-ui 式 setup）的独立可安装插件包。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤集合 + Gallery 预览页（仿 Codex-Dream-Skin / DreamSkin.cc）。每个皮肤是符合官方标准（turtle-ui 式 setup）的独立可安装插件包。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）Put DeepSeek Harness in your pocket: run dsh web on your computer and access it synchronously by scanning a QR code on your phone (LAN + public network, real‑time screen mirroring)
description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Teams 多智能体协作插件，支持多个 AI Agent 组成团队，协同完成复杂任务，实现任务分配、并行执行、成员通信与团队协作。 AgentTeams plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: A persistent, unified memory layer for all your AI agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, DSH), backed by Markdown and Milvus.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: A new SOTA for RAG — an original retrieval architecture and an open-source knowledge base for humans and agents.

基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的远程访问方案，通过低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 网络，支持使用 PC、移动端 和 Web 随时访问本地设备上的DSH 、CodeX、Cursor、Claude Code等工作区。 (Built on DeepSeek Harness plugins, this low-latency, end-to-end encrypted P2P solution lets PC, mobile, and web clients access local DSH, Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code workspaces.)
description.zh: 通过端到端加密通道远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 及兼容的编码工作区，支持自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输、设备授权、工作区文件、只读预览、终端和可选的 Codex Remote。

description.en: Provides a local-first AI novel writing workbench with outlines, chapters, and revision tools.
description.zh: 提供本地优先的 AI 小说创作工作台，包含大纲、章节和修订工具。

description.en: 给 AI Agent 的中文互联网研究 Skill：检索 8 大平台最近 30 天的讨论，追踪跨平台热点，生成附原始来源的报告，并提供每日全网热榜。支持 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw。
description.zh: 帮 AI 助手检索国内 8 大平台近 30 天讨论，追踪跨平台热点并生成带来源的研究报告。

description.en: DSH × Blender 直连插件 v3.0.6：15 个模型工具让 AI 驱动 GUI Blender（视口 / 自定义视角 / 无头 worker / 作业层 / 事务回滚 / 配方库），34 family / 228 op 契约层；npm 安装 + addon zip，GUI 优先、无头备用；dsh-TUI 选中 chip / @ 提及 / /blender，随包建模 skill，支持 WSL / Windows / macOS。
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 通过直连 TCP 通道驱动本地 Blender，提供 15 个工具：视口帧、自定义视角渲染、Python 执行、无头与作业卸载、事务回滚，以及 34 个 family / 228 个 op 的规划层。

description.en: A pre-execution guard for AI coding agents. It blocks destructive Git and file system commands, plus common attempts to access sensitive files, before a tool call runs. Supports Amp Code, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Devin CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi.
description.zh: 执行前守卫，在工具调用运行前拦截破坏性 Git 与文件系统命令，以及对 SSH 密钥、.env 等机密文件的访问。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Generates image candidates, supports conversational character card editing, scenario mode, and material extraction for text-based games.
description.zh: 生成候选项，支持对话式人物卡编辑、剧本模式与素材抽取。

description.en: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: Shared local memory, session history search, cross-agent handoff, and uncommitted code recovery across 43 coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw & more (CLI & MCP). One Go binary, zero LLM calls.
description.zh: 读取本机上其他四十二个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等），包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness with a read-only credits overview and model management.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，每次刷新按上游目录读取每个模型的积分倍率，支持逐模型图片输入开关、带自动换号的账号池、手动每日签到，以及卡片与输入框里的只读积分胶囊读数。

description.en: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。
你的AI学习搭档：定路线、讲知识、做项目，边学边做，学透一门科目
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

description.en: Software-engineering method pack for coding agents, with skills for baseline-first planning, systematic debugging, prompt hygiene, verification before completion, and repair/retirement tracking.
description.zh: 面向编码 Agent 的软件工程方法包，提供基线优先规划、系统化调试、提示词卫生、完成前验证，以及修复/退役双轨跟踪技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地视频制作与设计插件：多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里本地剪视频、套模板做设计，多轨编辑加实时预览，还能直接导出真实文件。

description.en: Anime Garden for DSH: search anime torrent resources from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组 and ANi inside DSH — via chat, a sidebar panel with fansub and type filters, a seasonal calendar, and an in-app floating player.
description.zh: Anime Garden 的 DSH 插件：在 DSH 内搜索来自動漫花園、蜜柑计划、萌番组和 ANi 的动画 BT 资源——支持对话搜索、按字幕组和类型筛选的侧边栏面板、新番周历，以及站内浮窗播放。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站，读字幕挑出值得的、写一份日报，值得的 @ 你
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 SillyTavern 类文字游戏 Agent，支持候选项生成、对话式人物卡编辑、剧本模式与素材抽取。
Eyes for text-only DSH agents: built-in free vision chain (anonymous OVHcloud endpoint) plus 11 pixel-level vision tools, one command, no Python.
description.zh: 给纯文本 DSH 智能体装上眼睛：内置免 key 免费视觉链 + 11 个像素级视觉工具，一条命令安装，无需 Python。

description.en: Offers unlimited long-term memory for AI assistants, enabling context retention across sessions and tasks.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自媒体工作台插件：一句话记灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜
description.zh: 一句话记下灵感，自动生成脚本、封面、配图和分镜，自媒体创作全流程一站搞定。

description.en: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the credential never reaches the model.
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：盯一个 GitHub 仓库，issue/PR 有变化就唤醒本会话；需已登录 gh CLI，凭证留在插件内，不进模型。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.
description.zh: 手机 App 的对端插件，自身可作无头宿主单独运行（不需要桌面外壳或 Electron）：经中转隧道或局域网配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、新建与操控 DSH 会话、订阅设备实时事件流，并以可吊销的设备凭据鉴权。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
description.zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

description.en: The desktop app has its own refresh button. Edited a plugin but a run is still going? Refresh. Window sluggish after hours of use? Refresh. One button fixes both — running sessions, queued messages and drafts are untouched.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端自己的刷新按钮。开发插件要重启，可手里还有任务在跑？刷新一下！开久了页面越来越卡？刷新一下！一个按钮解决这些烦恼，正在进行的会话、排队消息和草稿都不受影响。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
description.zh: 管理 soul.md 人设卡与长期记忆，支持按工作区和会话选择人设，并提供读取和更新工具。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
description.zh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：插件发现、安装、升级、开关与卸载一站完成，跟随 Web / Desktop 宿主 profile；4,000+ 条社区目录搭配可自定义精选清单，附 8 个 agent 工具与独立 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或账号。

description.en: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
description.zh: 把一段循环短片铺成聊天背景（可调透明度），启动时再播放一段有声片头动画。首次启动若为浅色主题，会一次性切到深色（附撤销提示）。

description.en: Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat
Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
description.zh: 在专用浏览器中按每日时段和额度观看抖音，共享本地人格与兴趣，提供原生设置、自检、用量和观看日报。回复与分享限定所选好友和群聊，群聊仅在被 @ 或叫到设定昵称时回复；公开评论需单独开启。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer). v0.19 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.19.2 or newer (0.19.5 is latest). Settings, dashboard and composer chip keep working on both the legacy and the rc.2 host APIs.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。v0.16 把记忆图谱升级为可交互 3D 球面（Canvas 手绘、零依赖）：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、拖节点 3D 整理布局、双击空白重置、自动慢转（尊重减少动态效果）；悬停或点击节点即时高亮邻居（位移+时长点击阈值），配色随浅色/深色面板自适应。v0.17 新增图谱搜索（排序匹配，镜头飞到命中的节点并点亮邻居）、节点的「在 Finder 中显示 / 复制路径」（等待命令结果，失败自动复制路径兜底）、Windows 兼容（路径变量展开、CRLF 读写保留换行风格、explorer 参数与退出码处理、工作区大小写匹配），README 精简并加入真实截图。v0.18（issue #8）新增 boot 快照模式：session 在本会话固化 boot 块，会话中途写记忆不再让前缀缓存失效（最近动态改走独立的靠后 context 段），默认仍是 live；双击记忆节点改为在 DSH 右侧栏打开该文件（打不开时回退系统文件管理器）。v0.19 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.19.2 或更新版本（最新 0.19.5）。设置面板、看板与输入框 chip 在老宿主与 rc.2 上均可工作。

description.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: a specialist MCP marketplace and manager panel for Model Context Protocol data sources. Connect enterprise, financial, legal, patent, research and geospatial data; manage authorization, search tools and troubleshoot connections. Supports OAuth, API keys and HTTP/stdio. Provider permissions and fees apply.
description.zh: MCP连接器：DeepSeek Harness 的专业 MCP 市场、数据市场与 MCP 管理面板，汇聚企业、金融、法律、专利、科研和地理等 Model Context Protocol（MCP）数据源。通过超百个 MCP连接器接入 MCP Server，支持连接管理、授权配置、跨连接搜索工具与排障；支持 OAuth、API Key、HTTP/stdio。由企查查/QCC团队维护；数据权限与费用以各服务商为准。

description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).
description.zh: Mnemon 深度集成：本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。

description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.
description.zh: 按会话分开的长期记忆，会随时间变淡，按证据分召回、每轮注入几条到系统提示词里。

description.en: DSH 壁纸引擎：本机 WE 壁纸实时渲染，视频/网页/开机动画/桌宠皮肤，一键拉取在线素材。

Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Visible agent browser for DSH over CDP, also driving egolite, Tabbit, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Lightpanda backends. Only bcdp_status stays resident (401 chars); the other 33 context-optimized bcdp_* tools unlock per activity batch, so non-browser sessions pay no schema tax (-91.9% measured). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices; non-CDP channels (ego CLI / Tabbit CLI) sync frames by 3s polling. Cross-version support for DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 (exact enumeration of 10 rc).
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入），同时驱动 egolite、Tabbit、Chrome、Edge、Brave 与 Lightpanda 后端。常驻只有 bcdp_status（401 字符），其余 33 个经过上下文优化的 bcdp_* 工具按活动批次解锁——不碰浏览器的会话不缴 schema token 税（实测 -91.9%）。实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；非 CDP 通道（ego CLI / Tabbit CLI）以 3s 轮询同步画面。DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 跨版本支持（精确枚举 10 个 rc）。

description.en: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Task ledger: a dsh plugin that has the agent create, claim, advance and close tasks, writing each step straight into a plain-text ledger in the workspace so the owner, the current state and the next step stay on record; no cloud service is involved, single-user and multi-user both work with Git synchronisation, and a control panel summarises in-flight, overdue and stalled work with weekly trends.
description.zh: 任务台账：任务由代理创建、认领、推进与结案，每一步直接写入工作区内的纯文本台账，使负责人、当前状态与下一步全程留痕；不涉及云服务，单人多人皆可用、以 Git 同步，看板汇总进行中、逾期与停滞的任务与每周趋势。

description.en: Music player for DeepSeek Harness with local library scanning, playlists, synced lyrics, online metadata matching, tag and cover editing, a cover grid, and a real-time spectrum bar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐播放器：曲库扫描、歌单、同步歌词、在线元数据匹配、标签与封面编辑、封面网格和实时频谱条。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
description.zh: 不另开窗口：用右栏内置浏览器，同一份 cookie、同一处登录，指针走到哪点到哪。

description.en: Startup animation and chat wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-act boot animation with custom animation import and three configurable transitions (first-act entry, act join, second-act exit), plus static-image and muted loop-video chat backgrounds (Wallpaper Engine project folders, custom video directories, random rotation, per-video delete).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸插件：两幕冷启动动画，支持导入自定义动画与三段自定义转场（第一幕入场、两幕衔接、第二幕退场）；聊天背景支持静态底图与静音循环视频（识别壁纸引擎项目文件夹、自定义视频目录、随机轮换、单个删除）。

description.en: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
description.zh: 通知提醒 / 消息提醒 / 消息通知 / 桌面通知弹窗 / 桌面提醒 / 弹窗通知、弹窗提醒 / 任务提醒、任务完成提醒 / 后台提醒、回复完成提醒 / 审批提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或任务、回复跑完时，弹出系统通知（可操作提醒、审批通知、完成通知）与提示音，并标记标签页标题；这是一款 DSH 通知提醒插件、DSH 提醒插件、消息通知插件，设置页可开关提醒、调音量、切换中英文通知语言。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Hosts QQ chats as DeepSeek Harness sessions: one QQ conversation maps to one DSH session that survives restarts, per-speaker tool permissions, three-layer memory with nightly consolidation, optional QQ-number binding that ties openids to QQ numbers so memories survive a bot or AppID change (binding is voluntary, never required, and never guessed from nicknames), four-section personas, context compaction, a ten-page sidebar panel, and a setup wizard that installs the Roost kernel and ai-chat plugin. Anyone in a paired QQ group can chat with the bot by default; only the owner gets the full local toolset.
description.zh: 把 QQ 会话接进 DeepSeek Harness：一个 QQ 会话对应一个 DSH 会话、重启后映射保留，按说话人分档收放本地工具，三层记忆（事实 / 日记 / 图谱）+ 凌晨巩固，可选的 QQ 号绑定把 openid 对上 QQ 号 / 群号，换机器人（换 AppID）后旧记忆照样读得到（绑定完全自愿、非必需，昵称候选只提示不自动绑），人格四段式，上下文压缩，侧栏十页面板，接入向导会自动装好 Roost 内核与 ai-chat 插件。接好的 QQ 群里任何人都能和机器人聊天；只有主人拿得到完整的本地工具。

description.en: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

description.en: Manages client-side plugins for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to install, enable, or remove extensions easily.
description.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness客户端插件，支持用户轻松安装、启用或移除扩展。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: Archives, stores, and organizes entire sessions for later retrieval, ensuring conversation history is preserved and accessible.
description.zh: 归档并存储整个会话，便于日后检索，确保对话历史得以保存和访问。

description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。

description.en: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
description.zh: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

description.en: Provides internationalization utilities for the DeepSeek Harness web plugin ecosystem, supporting translations across the workshop.
description.zh: 为插件生态提供国际化与翻译支持，方便多语言界面开发。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到 DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输，用 slash 命令管理会话、工作区、模型、权限等等，目标是在微信端还原 DSH 的原生体验。

description.en: A single-character agent that lives across QQ (via SnowLuma / OneBot 11), Bilibili and Douyin (the Douyin channel needs an always-on Windows desktop): persona cards with slowly evolving traits, per-person memory with Ebbinghaus decay and correction, a virtual clock driving a daily routine, proactive messages, auto-extracted memories, and a ten-tab settings panel covering retrieval, persona, routine, memory inspection, channels, habits, models and usage. QQ groups are deny-by-default: a group is answered only when it is on the allowlist or allGroups is explicitly switched on, and it still has to @-mention the bot. Private chats answer QQ friends only. Bilibili/Douyin auto-reply is off by default, limited to the owner, allowlist and mutual follows on Bilibili, and to the owner and allowlist on Douyin unless reply-to-everyone is explicitly enabled. Vendors MIT-licensed code from dsh-qq-bridge and dsh-douyin-bridge, credited in-source with their LICENSE files; it does not need either installed alongside.
description.zh: 活在 QQ（经 SnowLuma / OneBot 11）、B站、抖音（抖音通道需一台常开的 Windows 桌面）三端的单角色智能体：人格卡与慢慢长出来的人格、按人隔离的记忆（艾宾浩斯衰减、可纠正、聊完自动记）、虚拟时钟驱动的作息与主动开口；设置面板共十个标签，覆盖检索、人格、自走、记忆检视、三端通道、习惯、模型与用量。QQ 群默认拒绝：只有列进群白名单、或显式打开「所有群」的群才会被回应，且仍需 @ 它；私聊只回 QQ 好友。B站 / 抖音自动回复默认关闭：B站只回主人、白名单与互关，抖音只回主人与白名单（「回所有人」需另行打开）。内置了 dsh-qq-bridge 与 dsh-douyin-bridge 的 MIT 授权代码，源码与 LICENSE 内均有署名；不必与这两个插件同装。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Fixes plugins a DSH upgrade left behind: rehearse each rejected plugin in a throwaway home, grant a reversible exact-version exemption when it boots, and refuse when it does not. Also a multi-host compatibility matrix, a public table of every catalogued plugin, and a read-only plugin_health tool.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 升级后被落下的插件：每个被拒绝的插件先在一次性环境里试装试启动，能启动才写一条可撤销的精确版本豁免，不能启动就明确拒绝。另有：多宿主兼容矩阵、覆盖全部已收录插件的公开兼容表，以及只读的 plugin_health 工具。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.

Wenyuan Pavilion: an AI Team workbench for DSH with owned tasks, independent acceptance, an append-only ledger and concurrent projects. Install it into its own profile (dsh plugin --profile ai-team add @suifei/dsh-ai-team), not web or desktop: its patch sets that profile's sandbox to danger-full-access and approvals to never, and the member agents run with full access. The project's PMO acts automatically by default (every 60 s it resolves pending decisions and wakes owners to dispatch the next tasks); turn off PMO auto to send decisions to your inbox.
description.zh: 文渊阁：DeepSeek Harness 的 AI Team 工作台——有 owner 的 Task、独立验收、append-only 账本与并发 Project。请装进专用 profile（dsh plugin --profile ai-team add @suifei/dsh-ai-team），不要装进 web 或 desktop：插件的 patch 会把该 profile 的沙箱设为 danger-full-access、审批设为 never，成员 Agent 以完全权限运行。项目的 PMO 默认自动运行（每 60 秒自动处理待决事项，并唤醒负责人派发下一批任务），关掉“PMO 自动”后决策才会进你的收件箱。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.
description.zh: 微信（个人微信，iLink Bot API）通道：在微信里直接对话 DSH agent，支持图片、文件收发与语音转写。一个微信会话可挂多条 DSH 会话（/new、/list、/use 切换，切走不销毁），全部配置项都能在设置页里查看和修改。已上架 npm（dsh-plugin-weixin）。

description.en: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。

description.en: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.
description.zh: 别的记忆插件让 AI 记住更多，我们让 AI 只记住对的：Agent 只能提案，人工审核才进主库（三库分离 + 不可变审计日志）；召回走 SQLite FTS5/BM25、零模型调用（实测 p50 2.3ms），记忆账本摊开召回成本与有用率。一个库接 DSH / Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / MengBot（任意 MCP 客户端）；v0.31 起内置五套一键切换皮肤（默认暗色 / 波普 / 明亮 / 生化危机 / 蜘蛛侠）与全幅主题头图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型、同样的思考强度，只花更少的输出 token，全程提示词侧。默认只开「精简输出」（late 模式，第 4 步后生效），其余开关默认关、可单独打开；工具输出很长时再开「截短工具输出」那个。本机实测、非榜单成绩：输出偏长的 30 对任务，只开截短开关时 0.756× 耗时、输出 token −21%；6 个真实 `pallets/click` PR 共 24 对，0.805× 耗时、token −23%。在官方 SWE-bench Lite 题目定义上用自建 harness 量不出收益（8 题、三次独立跑合池 72 对：墙钟 0.933×、token 0.903×，墙钟仍跨 1；同一配置单跑之间就差三成），往截短上再叠别的开关反而更差。数字与复现见仓库。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: Schedules a daily, weekly or monthly GitHub Trending digest, has a local trendradar core write Chinese summaries and period recaps, commits them to your own repo and opens the pull request, and shows an overview, digest, run history, subscription and settings workbench.
description.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月周期定时生成 GitHub 趋势日报，由本地 trendradar 核心写中文简介与周期总结、提交到你自己的仓库并开 PR，内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: 2-4 real Chats you rearrange entirely from the keyboard, save as named layouts, and jump through by which pane needs you.
description.zh: 把 2 到 4 个真实对话并排放在一个窗口里，每个窗格都是完整聊天界面，方便对比和同时干活。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型处理视觉任务：粘贴图片后自动切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，支持图片问答、多图比较、长截图 OCR、截图还原前端 UI、元素定位与像素对比。默认无需 API Key——图片经作者自建的免费服务处理，每台机器每天 100 张；也可改为指向自己的服务商。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree, Git panel (commit graph, push/pull, per-file revert), SSH hosts and a real PTY terminal on the left, while the official DSH conversation stays docked on the right so tool calls, file edits, approvals and session history keep working as you code. Built on a craft-first belief: write it by hand, understand every change, treat AI as an assistant and stay the first owner of your software.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 IDE 模式：点工作区「…」菜单一键把主面板变成 VS Code 风格工作台——左侧 Monaco 编辑器、文件树、Git 面板（提交图/推送/拉取/逐文件还原）、SSH 主机与真实 PTY 终端，右侧原样停靠官方 DSH 会话，写代码时工具调用、自动改文件、审批与会话历史照常可用。作者主张「古法编程」：亲手写、每个改动心中有数，AI 是助理，你是软件的第一责任人。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（通义灵码国内版 / 国际版）模型接入 DSH，支持按区域的多账号池、每日签到、自动换号与只读积分展示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Provides a plugin marketplace within DSH to search, download, and install community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。
